# Project consistency check

*Generated by index/tools/check-project.py on each run of run-all.sh. Do not edit by hand. It lists where the documents and the input tables disagree with this run's results or with each other, and changes nothing: each finding is for Espen or a later session to decide. Decision briefs and sources/ are records of their day and are not checked for headline numbers.*
